name: Render
label: Render API
description: Render API via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://api-docs.render.com/. Operations: service_get, service_list, deploy_trigger, deploy_get, env_get, env_set, listen. env_set PUT /services/{serviceId}/env-vars body is a JSON array of {key,value} or {key,generateValue} (bodyMap $; https://api-docs.render.com/reference/update-env-vars-for-service). Auth secret api_key is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). listen/trigger are kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: service_get | service_list | deploy_trigger | deploy_get | env_get | env_set | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen/trigger are ingress: they do not call HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'service_get'.

schema.label: serviceId
schema.description: Render service id (srv-…). Path for service_get, deploy_*, env_*. Example: srv-abc123.

schema.label: envVars
schema.description: env_set whole-body JSON array for PUT /services/{serviceId}/env-vars. Each item is {key, value} or {key, generateValue:true}. PUT replaces ALL service env vars; omitted keys are deleted. Does not auto-deploy — call deploy_trigger after. Example: [{"key":"NODE_ENV","value":"production"}]. https://api-docs.render.com/reference/update-env-vars-for-service

children.label: value
children.description: Variable value. Omit when generateValue is true.

children.label: generateValue
children.description: When true Render generates a secret value.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Page size for service_list and env_get. 1–100. Example: 20.

schema.label: cursor
schema.description: Pagination cursor from a previous service_list or env_get. Example: Y3Vyc29y.

schema.label: clearCache
schema.description: deploy_trigger. EXACT: clear | do_not_clear. Default do_not_clear. Example: clear.

schema.label: commitId
schema.description: deploy_trigger optional git SHA to deploy. Example: a1b2c3d.

schema.label: imageUrl
schema.description: deploy_trigger optional image URL for image-backed services.

schema.label: type
schema.description: service_list service type. EXACT: web_service | private_service | background_worker | static_site | cron_job. Example: web_service.

schema.label: env
schema.description: service_list runtime filter. EXACT: docker | elixir | go | node | python | ruby | rust | image. Example: node.

schema.label: suspended
schema.description: service_list. EXACT: suspended | not_suspended. Example: not_suspended.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: service_get, service_list, deploy_trigger, deploy_get, env_get, env_set, listen. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon stateful budget (~300s).

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
